hypothesis: After an effective revolving-credit maturity extension that preserves or increases committed capacity, a cash-secured put has higher net returns than matched ordinary-day cash-secured puts.
universe: Sponsor top-100 tickers already present in the cached disclosure survey
include_rules: Supporting text from the filing (all tags allowed) must establish an executed revolving-credit extension or replacement, effective by filing date.
Maturity improvement must be explicit or follow from the known old expiration and stated new term. A generic newly established facility without that comparison does not qualify.

Old and new committed capacity must be quantifiable and nondecreasing. A maturity amendment to an existing explicitly sized facility, with no disclosed capacity reduction, counts as preserving that stated commitment but is flagged as an amendment-capacity proxy.
Earlier cached 2024-2025 disclosure text may establish an old facility only if its date precedes the event and its size, agreement date, and description identify the same facility.
An explicit increase plus actual maturity extension may qualify when the old exact maturity date is absent; do not invent that date.
For replacement of multiple facilities, aggregate old commitments only when the filing explicitly links their termination to the replacement.
exclude_rules: Acquisition-linked financing or completed acquisition in the same filing.
Future-effective or conditional execution, optional unexercised extensions, term loans alone, commercial-paper programs alone.
Missing evidence for maturity improvement or committed-capacity comparison.
A stated commitment reduction; additional optional accordions are not committed capacity.
entry_note: Root pricing harness uses next-trading-session-or-later entry and fixed costs; no same-day availability claim.
contract_note: Fixed sponsor 5 percent OTM 3-6 month cash-secured put; root reports prescribed horizons and sensitivity without selecting best.
audit_method: Human reading of preexisting event excerpts, locked before returns; offline extractor joins frozen accession annotations to cached source records. This is not an automated NLP classifier.
limitations: Retrospectively generated sponsor labels, not archived point-in-time labels.
Excerpts may omit amendments or conditions; qualifiers explicitly record inference versus direct statement.
No claim that this dataset measures a material reduction in refinancing risk.
Small qualifying sample and repeated issuers limit inference.
